responsibility: Implements the main C-side backend for the TILE-Gx target by defining target hooks, ABI logic, builtin handling, address and constant legitimization, instruction cost/scheduling support, varargs lowering, calling convention decisions, trampoline/thunk and profiling assembly emission, operand printing, and other machine-dependent code-generation helpers. This file is the central hook implementation that connects generic GCC middle-end and RTL expansion to TILE-Gx-specific behavior, including option override for code models/PIC, scalar and vector mode support, return and argument register rules, target builtins, scheduler/reorg callbacks, and final targetm initialization.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable C/C++ backend logic for TILE-Gx—implementing target hooks and wiring up `targetm`, including option override, calling/return ABI decisions, builtin expansion, address legitimization, scheduling/reorg, and asm emission—whereas `tilegx.h` provides declarative target macros and register/layout definitions, `tilegx.md` defines RTL instruction patterns and expanders, and `tilegx.opt` declares the target’s command-line options and generated option variables.
